text:
Gentlemen, I know well

of poisons...



Gentlemen, I know well of the poisons

of literature:

the shameless and terrible tyranny

of an impure Beauty

that stains our lips with word,

our eyes with figure,

and the brain with dreams or sins,

in flagrant, diabolical imposture.

I desire it for no one, and no one

should ever desire it,

but blessed are those who submit

to its dark gaze.

translation.title: Gentlemen, I Know Well...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Jodra's ironic warning against literature's poisonous beauty.
